searchText: question: are we trying to move into a REST API instead of a JSON-RPC API or is the API being written in REST but there will be an equivalent JSON-RPC API? context: https://ethereum.github.io/eth2.0-APIs/ We are moving into REST API Nothing stops client to expose json-rpc/grpc/graphql in addition to rest api understood it would be good to define a pattern where spec can be written in REST and easily translated to JSON-RPC for example if an endpoint is `GET /node/syncing/` it would be assumed to have method `node_syncing` with params `[]` https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs/issues/37 if you would like to take a look and comment on proposal for rest of endpoints > it would be good to define a pattern where spec can be written in REST and easily translated to JSON-RPC <@!292230513177919488> There is a lot of tools for translating openapi schema into other standards https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs/issues/26 Great! This is useful going to take a look further

excerpts.author: pedrouid
excerpts.content: question: are we trying to move into a REST API instead of a JSON-RPC API or is the API being written in REST but there will be an equivalent JSON-RPC API?

excerpts.author: mpetrunic
excerpts.content: We are moving into REST API

excerpts.author: mpetrunic
excerpts.content: Nothing stops client to expose json-rpc/grpc/graphql in addition to rest api

excerpts.author: pedrouid
excerpts.content: it would be good to define a pattern where spec can be written in REST and easily translated to JSON-RPC

excerpts.author: pedrouid
excerpts.content: for example if an endpoint is `GET /node/syncing/` it would be assumed to have method `node_syncing` with params `[]`

excerpts.author: mpetrunic
excerpts.content: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs/issues/37 if you would like to take a look and comment on proposal for rest of endpoints
